lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Ah... another soul seeks my domain.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Your daughter... taken by one of my demons.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Find the guilty one, and perhaps... I'll return her.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: But be warned - demons are masters of deception.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Some speak only truth. Others, only lies.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Place the culprit in the center of my circle.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Then... we shall weigh their soul.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: One took your daughter. Find them.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Ask your questions. Examine their belongings.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Truth-tellers cannot lie. Liars cannot tell truth.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Drag the guilty one to the center.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: But this was merely the beginning.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Your mind is sharper than I expected.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: The guilty one laughs at your mistake.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: You're getting closer to your daughter.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: But the demons here are craftier still.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: One more circle of demons remains.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Succeed here, and you'll face the ultimate test.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: You've proven yourself against my demons.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: But now... a different challenge awaits.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Human souls. Mortals who lived, loved, and sinned.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: So close to the end, and yet you stumble.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Some are good. Some are evil.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: The weak and strong of each.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: The weak evil will destroy the weak good.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: The strong evil will destroy both.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: But the strong good... resists the weak evil.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Arrange them so that ALL good souls survive.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Only then will I release your daughter.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: You've proven that even in Hell...

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: The flames have claimed another good soul.

lines.speaker: Lucifer
lines.text: Your daughter weeps in the darkness.
